dashboard.label: Drilldown

"md_map1": { "type": "splunk.markdown", "options": { "markdown": "### What this shows\n\nChicago crime markers, colored and iconed by offence. **Double-click** a marker to open a search on that marker's `location_description`.\n\n### The SPL\n\n```spl\n| inputlookup chicago-crime.csv \n... (markerColor and icon: case(like(description, ...)) per offence type - see Open in Search)\n| eval description = \"\".description.\"\", clusterGroup=\"default\"\n| table latitude, longitude, description, markerColor, icon, clusterGroup, location_description\n```\n\n### How it works\n\n1. `inputlookup` returns `latitude`, `longitude`, `description`, `location_description` and `primary_type` per incident.\n2. `case(like(description, ...))` sets `markerColor` and `icon` per offence type.\n3. `description` is wrapped in HTML bold (it is the click popup) and `clusterGroup=\"default\"` puts every marker in one cluster group.\n4. `location_description` is last in `table`. It is not a reserved Maps+ field, so Maps+ passes it to drilldown, where it arrives as `row.location_description.value`.\n5. With `drilldown` = `1` and `drilldownAction` = `dblclick`, a double-click fires the drilldown event handler.\n6. The handler opens a search URL with `row.location_description.value` filled in. Only markers fire drilldown.\n\n### Field formats and rules\n\n| Field | Format | Rule / gotcha |\n|---|---|---|\n| `latitude`, `longitude` | decimal degrees | Exact lowercase names; required. |\n| `description` | HTML | Click popup; escape event text. |\n| `markerColor` | named png color | A name outside Maps+'s fixed list renders a blank marker. |\n| `icon` | glyph name without prefix | `gavel`, not `fa-gavel`. |\n| `clusterGroup` | any string | Rows with different values never cluster together. |\n| `location_description` | any string | Non-reserved: keep it in the final `table` and it reaches `row.location_description.value`. |\n| `drilldown`, `drilldownAction` | options `\"1\"`/`\"0\"`, `dblclick` or `click` | Set both on the viz. |\n\n### Try it\n\n- Add `primary_type` to the end of `table`, then build a handler that uses `row.primary_type.value`.\n- Change `drilldownAction` to `click` in the viz options and compare with the second map.\n\n### Studio note\n\nThe classic link was a relative `search?q=...` URL. It is now `drilldown.customUrl` pointing at `/app/leaflet_maps_app/search`; check that values containing spaces open correctly.\n" } }, "md_map2": { "type": "splunk.markdown", "options": { "markdown": "### What this shows\n\nThe same drilldown, triggered by a **single click** on a marker. A `tooltip` field provides the hover text, because a click opens the drilldown instead of the popup.\n\n### The SPL\n\n```spl\n| inputlookup chicago-crime.csv \n... (markerColor and icon: case(like(description, ...)) per offence type - see Open in Search)\n| eval description = \"\".description.\"\", tooltip=description, clusterGroup=\"default\"\n| table latitude, longitude, description, tooltip, markerColor, icon, clusterGroup, location_description\n```\n\n### How it works\n\n1. `inputlookup` returns the incident rows, as in the first map.\n2. `case(like(description, ...))` sets `markerColor` and `icon` per offence type.\n3. `description` is wrapped in HTML bold and copied to `tooltip` (`tooltip=description`), so the text is available on hover.\n4. `location_description` stays in `table` and becomes `row.location_description.value`.\n5. `drilldownAction` = `click` makes a single click on a marker fire the same search link.\n\n### Field formats and rules\n\n| Field | Format | Rule / gotcha |\n|---|---|---|\n| `latitude`, `longitude` | decimal degrees | Exact lowercase names; required. |\n| `description` | HTML | Click popup; escape event text. |\n| `tooltip` | HTML | Hover text; use it with the click action. |\n| `markerColor`, `icon` | png color name, glyph name | Colors outside Maps+'s fixed list render blank. |\n| `clusterGroup` | any string | Rows with different values never cluster together. |\n| `location_description` | any string | Non-reserved: reaches drilldown as `row.location_description.value`. |\n\n### Try it\n\n- Edit `tooltip=description` to add `primary_type`'s value, for example `tooltip=description.\" - \".primary_type`, and keep `primary_type` in `table`.\n- Switch `drilldownAction` back to `dblclick`.\n\n### Studio note\n\nThis map uses the Esri World Imagery basemap from the original; it works in Studio without a key. The link target is a `drilldown.customUrl` (see the first map).\n" } } }, "layout": { "globalInputs": [], "tabs": { "items": [ { "label": "New tab", "layoutId": "layout_1" } ] }, "layoutDefinitions": { "layout_1": { "type": "absolute", "options": { "width": 1440, "height": 2665, "display": "auto", "backgroundColor": "#FFFFFF" }, "structure": [ { "item": "md_intro", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0, "w": 1440, "h": 334 } }, { "item": "viz_map1", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 0, "y": 334, "w": 720, "h": 760 } }, { "item": "md_map1", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 720, "y": 334, "w": 720, "h": 1246 } }, { "item": "viz_map2", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 0, "y": 1580, "w": 720, "h": 760 } }, { "item": "md_map2", "type": "block", "position": { "x": 720, "y": 1580, "w": 720, "h": 1085 } } ] } } } }
